credit: Charmander rig created by Milos Cerny and downloaded at http://www.miloscerny.com/
3D model created by Guilherme Lauck https://sketchfab.com/guilauck
modifications: Preserved original 60-bone rig and skin; removed old rig demonstration clip from v2.
Derived symmetric bent-arm stance using inspected world-space joint heads and axes.
Authored one new idle clip, 0–3 seconds at 30 fps, with subtle chest/head/arm movement and unchanged root/legs.
Reduced normal strength .65 to .18 and remapped roughness to .62–.86, retaining original base-color texture.
Assigned emissive material only to reliably isolated terminal tail triangles; no whole-body emission.

terminalTail.rule: All face vertices: Blender Y > .46, Z > .295, projection from Tail5 origin along its inspected longitudinal local X axis > .012.
terminalTail.limitation: Localized emission on existing solid terminal geometry; not a translucent animated flame simulation.

remainingDefects: Tail tip remains solid with a hard material boundary; emission alone is not a realistic flame.
Coarse scale pattern remains in original base-color image even after reducing normal relief.
Original skull/eyes/horns and tooth shapes remain stylized and are not approved as source-faithful photoreal Charmander identity.
Slight shoulder/underarm pinching remains in bent-arm stance.
No attack, hit, faint, locomotion, facial, or flame animation has been authored.
Four-weight export remains an approximation; sampled nearest-initial-pose correspondence is not a proof of every source vertex.
